unresolved_added: The Summary's three objectives are paper-implied because the official task statement is not in the source bundle.
“Probability of mistaken classification” and “probability of correct identification” are used with changing complements.
The source calls the CA powerful and accurate without an external long-horizon validation set.
Initial colony size 1000 is an estimate, not a measured nest count.
The 20% spatial margin and 12 km resolution are not sensitivity-optimized.
Treating every AGH individual as identical suppresses worker/queen/drone differences.
The single Vancouver-origin assumption ignores multiple introductions and transport.
Uniform geography and human footprint inside a cell can hide sharp barriers and cities.
Seasonal trends are assumed identical every year.
Non-JPG media are discarded without a loss audit.
The dataset retains reports with no images, but the downstream branches can have different missingness mechanisms.
Dropping null Notes and Lab Comments may select for more complete reporters.
NLTK tokenization, stopword removal and lemmatization can erase domain-specific phrases or negation.
LDA topic separation is not a test of predictive usefulness.
Generic words “found”, “hornet” and “bee” may still carry weak signal in combination.
Declaring text unimportant from word clouds alone is stronger than the shown diagnostic.
The population proxy assumes negative reports reflect human anxiety rather than AGH presence.
Public concern, publicity and agency campaigns can vary independently of population.
`-log(P)` is undefined or unstable for zero/near-zero population cells.
Barrier value `-infinity` can create numerical and boundary artifacts.
Qualitative city-map agreement is not independent validation of population density.
A 2925-cell grid creates computational cost that is not measured.
Moore neighborhood d=1 and retaining the current cell are modeling choices without calibration.
Softmax suitability probabilities do not include uncertainty in S.
Passive hitchhiking is acknowledged but its probability and destination are unspecified.
Concurrent updates need a conservation check across open boundaries.
North/south/east leakage makes the simulated total depend on the finite window.
West sea exclusion assumes no transport across the Strait of Georgia.
Summer/winter rate choices are taken from background facts rather than fitted to reports.
One-day timesteps and 10-20 km activity range are only rough unit translations.
Long-term stabilization of shape does not validate the 10,000-population projection.
The proposed later logistic equation is not actually estimated.
KL divergence direction and normalization are not explained for cell distributions.
Nine random initializations are too few for a general 95% interval claim.
“Longest 100” intervals select extremes and are not ordinary confidence intervals.
Bayes simplification assumes every visually intimidating AGH is reported.
The rare-event approximation drops terms without an error bound.
`p` and `M` are expected amounts, but their scales and units are not reconciled.
The report score is defined as a maximum over reports in a region/time, which can reward one noisy report.
Text is described as sentiment analysis although LDA is topic modeling and not sentiment inference.
Only 13 positive images are expanded to 87, so transformed copies are not independent evidence.
“All augmented images contain visible AGH” is a manual filter without agreement measurement.
VGG/kNN/SVM comparison lacks a frozen tuning protocol and uncertainty intervals.
Table 1's VGG-11+SVM AUROC 95.4% differs from the Summary's 94.4% headline.
The training/testing dates in the text overlap or reverse in places and require source-level reconciliation.
Class counts 60/300 and 27/500 do not obviously match the 13-image starting set and 87 augmentations.
VGG feature compression and SVM hyperparameters are not reproducible from the paper.
`predict_proba` scores are not shown to be calibrated probabilities.
Maximum probability over multiple images ignores disagreement and image count.
European hornet and cicada-killer examples are a tiny hand-picked look-alike test.
Calling look-alike negatives an adversarial attack overstates the evaluation.
The regional Gaussian M_r uses Euclidean coordinate distance without projection details.
Person-level false-report probability is assumed constant over regions and time.
Report frequency is interpreted as discredibility without modeling reporting effort.
ReLU-sine coefficients are fitted without uncertainty or held-out residual checks.
Seasonal report frequency may reflect insect biology, publicity, weather or workflow.
The q notation changes from a product term to a regional index and can confuse complements.
MLE scalar c≈0.05990657 lacks optimizer, uniqueness and variance details.
Positive and negative likelihood sums have no disclosed raw denominators.
The Bayesian probability without images degrades over time, suggesting stale CA state.
Alpha=0.1 is tuned on one period and may not transfer to later years.
AUROC can look strong under severe imbalance while target recall remains unknown.
Direct Baum-Welch transition updating fails because observations and the correlation matrix are sparse.
SIR is not fully implemented due to computation restrictions.
Particle count, proposal distribution, resampling and degeneracy diagnostics are absent.
Fresh reports are treated as observations of hidden suitability without a detection model.
The latest-positive/winter gate ignores transported insects and missed positives.
A one-year CA decrease supports only “possibly die out”, not eradication.
National parks and reservations may be underreported, so active search effort must be measured.
The memo's 90% accuracy and adjustable threshold advice should not be learned as calibrated performance or a staffing plan.
